# Zavron Solutions

> Zavron Solutions is a professional digital agency specializing in custom web development, enterprise WordPress & WooCommerce engineering, high-converting e-commerce, technical SEO, and UI/UX design for growing businesses and enterprises across the United States.

## Organization Identity
- **Legal Name**: Zavron Solutions
- **Website**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/
- **Canonical Entity ID**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/#organization
- **Email**: zavronsolutions@gmail.com
- **Primary Market**: United States (Nationwide service across all 50 states)
- **Business Model**: Full-service digital solutions agency (Design, Development, Optimization, Marketing)

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Custom Web Development
- **URL**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/web-development/
- **Focus**: High-performance, responsive business websites, modern web applications, scalable frontend/backend architectures, API integrations, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **Technologies**: Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, REST APIs.

### 2. WordPress & WooCommerce Development
- **URL**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/wordpress-development/
- **Focus**: Bespoke Gutenberg block themes, WooCommerce storefronts, decoupled headless WordPress architectures, database optimization, plugin curation, and enterprise security hardening.
- **Differentiators**: Zero plugin bloat, custom modular blocks, sub-second load times, hardened attack-surface defense.

### 3. E-Commerce Development
- **URL**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/ecommerce-development/
- **Focus**: Conversion-rate-optimized Shopify Plus and WooCommerce architectures, streamlined 1-page checkout flows, ERP/CRM synchronizations, and high-volume product catalog management.

### 4. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Technical SEO
- **URL**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/seo/
- **Technical SEO**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/technical-seo/
- **E-Commerce SEO**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/ecommerce-seo/
- **Focus**: Semantic HTML markup, structured JSON-LD schema graphs, crawl-budget optimization, Core Web Vitals auditing, topical authority clustering, and AI-search/GEO discoverability.

### 5. Local SEO & Google Business Profile Optimization
- **URL**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/local-seo/
- **Focus**: Google Map Pack ranking architecture, multi-location NAP consistency, hyper-local landing page architecture, and review management systems for US service businesses.

### 6. UI/UX Design & Design Systems
- **URL**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/ui-ux-design/
- **Focus**: User research, wireframing, high-fidelity interactive prototyping, design systems, accessible color palettes, and conversion-centered user flows.

### 7. Digital Marketing & Paid Search
- **Digital Marketing**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/digital-marketing/
- **Google Ads Management**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/google-ads/
- **Social Media Marketing**: https://www.zavronsolutions.com/services/social-media-marketing/
- **Focus**: High-intent search campaigns, Performance Max optimization, B2B lead generation, and multi-channel attribution.
